clue.text: Song comes from sporting equipment commercial

clue.text: Next to a dinner jacket, excellent new shirt

clue.text: Award for top town centre

clue.text: Awful pity Cern has no one to encode data

clue.text: Prepare care tips to run through

explanation.walkthrough: 'Prepare' looks like the definition, but it is the signal to rearrange.

clue.text: Secured horse between exercise and regular feeds

clue.text: Install program into mobile

clue.text: Go to nurse with a temperature
